examples.title: SciGym example
examples.prompt: You are investigating a biological system where all species are observable. Your goal is to discover the missing reactions. You do not need to add new species.
examples.scope: Initial task and incomplete model extracted from a public trajectory; solver thoughts and attempts omitted

inputs.name: Simulation environment
inputs.description: The interactive experiment interface is required and is not available in this static preview.

examples.output: Recover missing reactions in the model using the experiment interface.
examples.grading: Simulator-grounded recovery of system structure/parameters; use the task’s official metrics.
examples.reference_note: No reference answer is included in this preview.
